request.voice_description: Native Russian. Male, around 70 years old. Studio quality, clean close-mic recording. The old manager of a village water mill in the Russian north. Dry, precise, a bit formal, kind underneath. Lower-pitched aged voice, slightly hoarse and grainy but steady, with clear diction; measured unhurried pace, short businesslike questions and small pauses; a hint of bewildered warmth. Never frail, never comic, never theatrical.
